narrative:
Muskingum County has 53,071 registered voters, with 14.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 52.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 22.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.1% of registrants.
